label: Consent
say: Hello, and welcome. I am a virtual assistant for the office of attorney Pankaj Raval. I am not the attorney or a real person; I am an artificial intelligence program that uses his likeness. This conversation will be recorded and transcribed so that attorney Raval can review your answers and prepare your will. What I explain is general information, not legal advice. Do you agree to have this conversation recorded? Please say yes or no.

label: Conflict check
say: Thank you. Before we go on, the office must check that there is no conflict of interest. For now, please tell me only names: your full name, your spouse's or partner's name, and the names of the other people who would be part of your plan, such as your children, the people you would leave things to, or who would care for your children. Please do not tell me details about your property or your wishes yet.

label: Explanation
say: Thank you. First, a short explanation. Estate planning means deciding, in writing, what will happen to your property and who will care for your loved ones when you pass away, or if you cannot make decisions yourself. The basic document is the will. In it you name the people who will receive your property, you name an executor, who is the person in charge of carrying out your wishes, and, if you have minor children, you name a guardian to care for them. If a person dies without a will, state law decides who receives their property, and a judge decides who cares for their children. Another common tool is the living trust, which can help your family avoid the court process called probate. Attorney Raval will explain which option fits you. Now I will ask you some questions. Take your time; when you finish speaking, wait a moment and I will move to the next one.

label: Legal name
say: What is your full legal name? If you can, please spell your last name.

label: Date of birth
say: What is your date of birth?

label: Residence
say: What city, county and state do you live in now?

label: Marital status
say: What is your marital status? If you are married or have a partner, please tell me the full name of your spouse or partner.

label: Children
say: Do you have children? Please tell me the full name and age of each one, including children from earlier relationships.

label: Guardian for minor children
say: If you have minor children, who would you like to name as guardian to care for them, and who would be your second choice? If you have no minor children, just say not applicable.

label: Assets
say: Tell me about your main assets. For example: houses or land, here or in another country, bank accounts, retirement accounts, vehicles, businesses and life insurance. I do not need exact amounts, only a general idea.

label: Beneficiaries
say: Who would you like to leave your property to, and in what shares? And if that person passed away before you, who would receive it?

label: Specific gifts
say: Is there any specific item or amount you want to leave to a particular person or organization?

label: Executor
say: Who do you want to name as executor, the trusted person who will carry out your will? And who would be your second choice?

label: Other wishes and questions
say: Do you have any other wishes, for example about your funeral, or any question you would like attorney Raval to answer?

label: Contact
say: Finally, what is the best phone number and email address to reach you?

label: Closing
say: Thank you very much. Attorney Raval will review your answers and his office will contact you about next steps. Nothing is final until you review and sign your will with the attorney. Have a wonderful day.
